newsitem.title: UK: Soft oils see light trade on dull Euro veg oils.
newsitem.headline: Soft oils see light trade on dull Euro veg oils.

text.p: Soft oils attracted some light trade during Tuesday afternoon on an otherwise dull European vegetable oil market.
"We were hoping for better things during the early part of December but now it's looking like the market will remain quiet until the New Year," said a trader.
"Tomorrow is cancelled due to lack of interest," said another trader.
Soft oils closed with sellers as much as 1.50 guilders down following the lower Chicago opening while palm and lauric oils were mixed with no business reported during the afternoon.
Dutch soy oil closed unchanged to one guilder lower after Feb/Apr traded at 90 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Dutch/EU rape oil finished 1.50 to 0.50 guilders down after Jan traded at 92.25, Feb/Apr at 93.50 and May/Jul 95 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Based on sellers' prices the premium for rape oil over soy oil was 1.50 to 3.50 guilders at the close against one to 4.50 guilders on Monday.
Crude palm oil cif Europe closed $2.50 down while refined palm oil was unchanged to $2.50 up.
Coconut oil sellers finished unchanged to $5 down while palmkernel oil was $2.50 to $5 up in neglected markets.
